[Predictions]

Valter Walker is 100% getting heel hook #5 in his fight.
Going to speculate on some possible matchups here too... I wonder if this could maybe have DDP vs Usman as the main event?
Regardless I think Oezdemir is going to fight RDR on this card for sure and I'm leaning towards Whittaker being on this card vs Krylov instead of on UFC 329.
If DDP isn't the main here though, it's probably going to be Ankalaev against most likely Khalil, but I'm holding out hope for a Costa vs Magomed fight instead still. I'm thinking we could see some sort of Orolbai fight as the main card opener too, probably against like Kevin Holland, but imagine this turns out to be D-Rod's return fight.
These Abu Dhabi cards are always lowkey stacked so hope this one is as well.
